audit.whatIsWrong: EVEN / 6/10 matches a 50.17% win rate over 1507 games; kept.
audit.why: The lane is a race: Ornn owns the melee window, Kayle owns everything after it.
audit.corrected: diff and diffRating left; the phase prose reworded so the difficulty reads as a clock rather than a flat rating.

audit.whatIsWrong: Chart showed Ornn winning rows 1, 2, 5 and 6.
audit.why: Packet levelChart is Skill, Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, and the mirror kayle__ornn already flipped rows 1-2 to Skill and rows 3-6 to Kayle. The page's own whys[5] and whys[6] describe Kayle taking over, so the chart contradicted its own text.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 flipped in matched full/content pairs to Skill, Skill, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle, Kayle; ratings moved with them.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one of Kayle's abilities was named outside the ult, and no cooldown appeared anywhere.
audit.why: Radiant Blast is 900 range on 12s at rank 1 and reduces your resistances — it directly undercuts Ornn's Living Forge armour. Celestial Blessing heals on a flat 15s. Starfire Spellblade is a free auto reset on 8s and scales off missing health, so the wind-up is the burst tell. Divine Judgment is 160s at rank 1.
audit.corrected: Names and the 12s / 15s / 160s numbers written into the phases, trade lines and cooldown breakdown; the auto-reset tell and Grievous Wounds requirement added.

audit.whatIsWrong: Anti-heal was mentioned in Itemization but never tied to a trade decision.
audit.why: Celestial Blessing is a flat 15s heal; without Grievous Wounds Ornn's chip pattern simply does not stick.

edits.before: W brittle turns every trade into bonus %HP damage. Only take the trade when Kayle's Divine Judgment is down.
edits.after: Bellows Breath is not up yet and Radiant Blast is 12s of poke — trade autos, take CS, and hold the level even.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Kayle must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online, but a careful Kayle just farms behind minions — you can only punish the step-up, so hold the wave near you.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Divine Judgment's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Radiant Blast shreds your resistances and Celestial Blessing heals back your chip on 15s — she farms toward scaling and edges these levels.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Kayle's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God is your hardest all-in — but Divine Judgment only has to survive it. Bait the invulnerability, then re-engage with R.

edits.before: Iceborn Gauntlet is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Divine Judgment's cooldown.
edits.after: Iceborn Gauntlet helps, but her attack speed and range outpace it — force fights before it stops working.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Kayle carry threat 9.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Kayle carry threat 9.5/10: two items and she out-DPSes you through your CC. Close before the map decides instead of you.

edits.before: Q the pillar behind Kayle, E-dash through it for the knockup when his answer is down, and W-brittle the trade for the proc.
edits.after: Q the pillar behind Kayle, E into it for the knockup, then W-Brittle and proc — do it while Radiant Blast's 12s is down.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: E with no terrain in the line — no knockup, and Celestial Blessing heals back whatever chip you traded.

edits.before: Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Invulnerability on a 160s cooldown at rank 1 — bait it, then commit.

edits.before: That is Kayle's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Every CS she gets free buys the ranged spike that ends your lane — shove and deny.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: Fighting late from behind hands her the R-invulnerable window where your CC does nothing and she out-DPSes you.

edits.before: - Kayle Divine Judgment: matchup-defining — Her get-out at 6. Bait it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Kayle Divine Judgment: matchup-defining — 160s invulnerability at rank 1. Bait it before you commit. - Radiant Blast: 12s, shreds your resistances. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Divine Judgment: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If ahead, freeze and starve him.
edits.after: Trade around Celestial Blessing's 15s heal — buy Grievous Wounds or she undoes your chip. Deny CS; every level of hers is your lane clock.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — build your teamfight around that. Kayle carry threat: 9.5/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — build your teamfight around that. Kayle carry threat: 9.5/10 — anti-heal stays core, and never duel her once Divine Judgment is up.

notes: The page states Kayle's E goes ranged at level 11. Riot's kit text only says her passive grants attack range as she levels and does not give the thresholds, so I left every level-11 reference untouched — recorded as unverified. Kayle was called 'he/his' in several fields; I fixed the ones I rewrote, but breakdown.feeding, breakdown.wave, report[12].t and report[9].t still say 'his'.
